messages:
mike: Quick q — we're rolling out the new /v2/usage response shape. How should callers interpret `cached_tokens` / `cached_prefix_tokens` vs `prompt_tokens` for billing? i.e., do we expect clients to compute billed units as `prompt_tokens - cached_prefix_tokens + completion_tokens`? cc @sara
sara: short answer: yes — cached prefix tokens should not be billed. endpoint will keep `prompt_tokens` as the raw token count, and add `cached_prefix_tokens` to indicate how many of those came from prefix cache. billing = prompt_tokens - cached_prefix_tokens + completion_tokens. we'll also add `billable_tokens` field to make it explicit (backcompat note below). :+1:
alex: small nuance — what about partial cache hits where only first N tokens are cached and the server resumes generation? above formula still holds right?
jen: accounting perspective: we need a single, stable field we can reconcile against invoices. if you add `billable_tokens`, please also emit the same value in the usage export pipeline as `charged_units`. otherwise we'll be stuck mapping multiple fields. also include `origin` metadata per-request (values: `cache`, `runtime`, `mixed`) so we can debug anomalies.
sara: yep — partial hits are `mixed`. example response we'll return (informal):
```json
{
  "prompt_tokens": 120,
  "cached_prefix_tokens": 40,
  "completion_tokens": 30,
  "billable_tokens": 110,
  "origin": "mixed"
}
```
where billable_tokens = 120 - 40 + 30 = 110.
jen: good. one more: if a request is 100% served from cache (no generation), completion_tokens may be 0 and billable_tokens should be 0. we need logs to include `cache_hit: true` and `cache_key` (hashed) to reconcile.
billing-bot: heads-up — we've seen ~0.2% of requests with `cached_prefix_tokens` > `prompt_tokens` in staging. filing ticket #2345 for the runtime team. :thinking:
mike: ack. For backcompat: we'll keep `total_tokens` (old field) where `total_tokens = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens` for at least 6 months and add `billable_tokens` as the authoritative billing field. PR with schema changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/789. Please review — tagging @sara @alex @jen.
sara: i'll review the PR and add unit tests around partial cache logic and streaming behavior (`stream=true` should still include the same token fields in the final event).
alex: also note: older SDKs that only read `total_tokens` will overcount if they don't know about `cached_prefix_tokens`. ops: consider a server-side compatibility mode that writes `total_tokens` equal to `billable_tokens` when a `compat=legacy` query param is set.
jen: that would be helpful. final ask from accounting: include a `reconciliation_id` per request in the export (UUID) so we can map API events to invoice lines reliably.
mike: action items: 1) add `billable_tokens` + `origin` + `reconciliation_id` to response + usage export, 2) keep `total_tokens` for 6 months (emit both), 3) add logging for `cache_key` and `cache_hit` (ops ticket), 4) runtime to patch the `cached_prefix_tokens > prompt_tokens` bug (ticket #2345). I'll update the PR with fields and sample exports. Thanks all. :rocket:
